nodes.name: LoadImage
nodes.purpose: Valid local managed PNG RGB/RGBA/L/LA decoding, alpha choice, exact pixels/masks and raw digest; not catalogue widget admission, native invalid/missing paths or other formats/animation/EXIF/MPO.

nodes.name: LoadImagesFromDir
nodes.purpose: Valid selected managed prefix with files, exact lexical/islice image/mask results and actual downstream loads. Absolute native path strings projected to logical names; directory mask HW versus downstream BHW comparison axis explicit. Missing/empty/subdirectory-only native states formally excluded.

nodes.name: SaveMetadata
nodes.purpose: Bounded valid PNG metadata/pixel output and exact encoded bytes across three routes, explicit independently observed UUID4 names. Oversize/invalid PNG keyword and non-atomic host failure-side-effect purposes formally excluded.
